newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Hanover County, Va..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Hanover County, Va..

text.p: General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed bids will be received for the Board of Supervisors of the County of Hanover, Virginia, until 11:00 a.m., Richmond Time, on

at the office of Wheat First Butcher Singer, 901 East Byrd Street, Riverfront Plaza, West Tower, 4th Floor, Richmond, Virginia 23219, for the purchase of $7,940,000 General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997, described herein, at which time the bids will be publicly opened. No bids will be accepted by facsimile transmission or other electronic means.
Deadline for Receipt of Bids: 11:00 a.m. Richmond time
AA'' The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form in denominations of $5,000 or any multiple thereof. The Bonds will be dated January 1, 1997, and will mature in

installments, or have mandatory sinking fund installments, on July 15 in each of the years 1997 through 2016, inclusive. Bonds maturing on or after July 15, 2007, will be callable on or after July 15, 2006, as described in the detailed Notice of Bond Sale. The Bonds will be general obligations of the County, secured by a pledge of its full faith and credit. The approving opinion of Mays & Valentine, L.L.P., Richmond, Virginia, will be furnished to the
successful bidder at the County's expense.

Additional information, including the detailed Notice of Bond Sale, the Official Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement, may be obtained from Wheat First Butcher Singer, c/o James R. Johnson, 901 East Byrd Street,
Riverfront Plaza, West Tower, Richmond, Virginia 23219 (Telephone: 804/782-3254).
* Unless postponed, as described in the Notice of Bond Sale
